File: src/export/scheduler.ts

Update the scheduler logic when creating or advancing a weekly scheduled export so that a schedule created on its run day (such as Monday) calculates the next run time in the future rather than treating the current time as already passed or missed for that day, ensuring the first scheduled export is sent on its creation day.
args.title: Send first weekly scheduled export on creation day if created early
